about_the_game:
ANNIHILATE THE SWARM

Riftbound is a survivor-like bullet heaven built around build customization and massive enemy density. Wipe out thousands of entities with automated attacks, refine your build on the fly, and adapt to a constantly ramping difficulty curve.

CHAIN REACTIONS & SPARK COMBOS

Your abilities are designed to interact, allowing you to create chaotic screen-clearing combos.

  • Elemental Interplay: Mix contrasting elements to trigger massive area damage. Freeze a dense pack of enemies with a blizzard, then shatter them instantly with a kinetic shockwave.

  • Overlapping Effects: Combine different weapon behaviors and status effects. Stack heavy area-of-effect burns with high-frequency knockbacks to trap enemies in deadly choke points.

  • Visual Chaos: Push your build to the limit until the screen is filled with hundreds of active projectiles and status chains.

UPGRADE AND ESCALATE

  • Diverse Archetypes: Build your character your way. Choose from heavy melee weapons with high kinetic force to magic staves firing automated homing missiles.

  • Meta-Progression: Collect Essence during your runs to permanently upgrade base attributes and expand your starting weapon pool.

  • Optional Co-op: Enter the Rift solo or team up with a partner. Coordinate your loadouts to cover each other's weaknesses, draw aggression, or execute a high-risk revive in the middle of a horde.
